source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When you pick the Marshal’s unit [to fight](vsdata:core-rule/fight-step), you may activate this ability. Count enemy units up to 6″ from the Marshal. The unit’s melee attacks get +1 Attacks per counted unit, with a total bonus of at most +3.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.when: owning model’s unit selected to fight
